r1_r2_r3_controls_mandatory.policy: All three controls run on the same XDF capture; if any control passes binding threshold, F-ARTIFACT triggered

R1_random_tension_link.name: R1 random tension_link 5ch surrogate
R1_random_tension_link.method: synthesize 5ch tension_link signal as i.i.d. uniform U(-0.014, +0.014) per sample, NOT from CLM
R1_random_tension_link.clamp: ±0.014 (matches empirical W4 tension_link L1-norm range from #103 partial)
R1_random_tension_link.test: compute pair_B aggregate |r| with R1 substituted; compare to real |r| via KS-test on per-phase r distribution
R1_random_tension_link.fail_condition: KS p > 0.10 (R1 distribution indistinguishable from real)

R2_random_eeg_rotation_surrogate.name: R2 random EEG rotation surrogate
R2_random_eeg_rotation_surrogate.method: phase-randomize alpha-PLV time series via FFT rotation surrogate (preserve power spectrum, destroy phase structure)
R2_random_eeg_rotation_surrogate.test: compute pair_A aggregate |r| with R2 substituted; KS-test against real

R3_shuffled_phase_order.name: R3 shuffled phase-label permutation
R3_shuffled_phase_order.method: randomly permute P1-P6 phase labels (1000 iterations); recompute per-phase pearsonr
R3_shuffled_phase_order.test: compute permutation null distribution of binding_strength; compare real binding to null p99
R3_shuffled_phase_order.fail_condition: real binding p > 0.10 in null distribution

execution_order: 2. analyze_xdf.py computes real binding_strength + per-phase r
3. R1 surrogate generated, binding recomputed -> KS-test vs real
4. R2 surrogate generated, binding recomputed -> KS-test vs real
5. R3 permutation null built, real binding compared to null
r1_r2_r3_controls_mandatory.all_controls_required_pass: real binding must beat ALL THREE controls; if ANY control's KS-test p > 0.10, F-ARTIFACT triggered
